{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|eff= local

|gr1= Event Handlers

|descr= Adds a user action event handler to the current mission and returns its event handler index.


|s1= [[addUserActionEventHandler]] [keyName, event, expression]

|p1= keyName: [[String]] - action key name - see [[inputAction/actions]]

|p2= event: [[String]] - event name - see [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]. Can be one of:
* {{hl|"Activate"}}
* {{hl|"Deactivate"}}
* {{hl|"Analog"}}

|p3= expression: [[Code]] - expression that will be executed in [[missionNamespace]] when event handler fires.
* {{hl|{{Link|Magic Variables#thisEventHandler|_thisEventHandler}}}} returns the event handler index
* {{hl|{{Link|Magic Variables#thisEvent|_thisEvent}}}} returns the event type (the ''event'' parameter, either {{hl|"Activate"}}, {{hl|"Deactivate"}} or {{hl|"Analog"}})

|r1= [[Number]] - the index of the currently added UserAction event handler is returned

|x1= <sqf>private _ehId = addUserActionEventHandler ["ReloadMagazine", "Activate", { systemChat "reloading!"; }];</sqf>

|seealso= [[removeUserActionEventHandler]] [[removeAllUserActionEventHandlers]] [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]
}}
